title: Atypical Super-Hero Movies (like Unbreakable and Chronicle) and the potential future of the genre

commenti.body: Anyone still remember Super (2010) with Rain Wilson and Elliot Page? It was an extremely black comedy from James Gunn about a man wears a costume and who starts beating people in the streets with a wrench after his wife leaves him for a drug Dealer (Kevin Bacon). Part of the darkness in the film comes from his equal punishment of all offenders, like people who cut in line at movie theaters.
